title: bin-probes-report-to-the-watch
intention: Every standing WATCHME probe berthed in bin reports to harbor_master's watch verb with {ticket, holds, finding} stated against its own ticket's falsifier, and each spec names that receiver.
why: Every standing probe in bin mails with no verb and nothing uses it (835b5736bf2b D2); a88d6a368cfb built the watch verb that uses a WATCHME finding and 8ecb99998254 built watch_carry. Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a: build the receivers.
traces_to: 835b5736bf2b's falsifier (zero probe-bearing standing specs lack a receiver) and Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a; the 2026-09-30 ruling that a probe's data must have a consumer that USES it; RULE 1 (the build stays inside bin; base's helper through its public interface, harbor_master through its bus verb)
how: Measured 2026-10-03: 2 tickets at a rest carry a watchme probe under bin/probes/ (59a66e1c4a1a, 854db29ffddf). Read 2026-10-03: two standing tickets carry a probe under bin/probes, both posting to='harbor_master' with no verb. retention_window (854db29ffddf) is fails-shaped: TRUE when enough namespaces have turned over AND at least one can no longer show a previous run (a peephole). probescans_device_column_varies_with_the_world (59a66e1c4a1a) is TRUE on a stuck needle (identical columns past the limit, the failure) OR on two distinct columns with a resolved device that later changed (the success its enough clears on), so holds is not stuck_needle. Proofs naming them: test_retention_window_probe (calls the raw _carry and checks ticket == _OWNING_TICKET and the rows; never PROBE.to or verb), test_groundloop_pulse (the pulse roster), and launchers/probes/reported_but_unfixed_floor.py names retention_window only in prose. Each PROBE gets verb='watch' and carry=watch_carry(<its id>, _carry, <its predicate>), importing watch_carry from cairn.tools.base.probe (declared public). Each ticket's watchme spec gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} through the artifact door. A proof under bin/proofs reads the population from the commons and asserts each probe's verb, to, and live payload invariants.
falsifier: GREEN when every ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme.probe sits under bin has a probe whose PROBE posts verb 'watch' to 'harbor_master' and whose payload over live data carries ticket == that ticket's id, holds a bool, and a non-empty finding whenever holds is False; and every such spec names receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} with watchme_spec_error naming no receiver fault. RED if any standing bin spec lacks the receiver, or if a converted payload's ticket is a path or another id. WRONG INTENT if a bin probe's data has a reader other than its own ticket's FIXME that only Akien could name.
watchme: none, because what this child's probes say is read by harbor_master's watch verb (a88d6a368cfb, PROVED), and whether they ever fire is 164da559823d's and acb4ecd84364's watch (CairnCommons/tickets/164da559823d-*.json); a probe on probes reporting would need a receiver of its own.
children: none, because the change is 2 PROBE declarations and their specs, all inside bin.
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) Which probes and how: 59a66e1c4a1a probescans_device_column_varies_with_the_world (holds=_holds), 854db29ffddf retention_window (fails=_trigger). In each file under bin/probes/: append watch_carry to the existing 'from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...' line; use the probe's id constant (named per probe below, added as `_TICKET_ID = "<id>"` after the import block when absent); in PROBE = Probe(...) replace 'carry=_carry,' with 'verb="watch",' and 'carry=watch_carry(<const>, _carry, <pred>),'. probescans_device_column_varies_with_the_world holds _OWNING_TICKET as a slug and retention_window holds _OWNING_TICKET as owning_ticket('logger-for-bash') (a path); both constants stay (test_retention_window_probe asserts the raw _carry's ticket == _OWNING_TICKET, and _carry is not edited), and each gains _TICKET_ID with its 12-hex id. probescans_device_column_varies_with_the_world's trigger is TRUE on a stuck needle OR on variance confirmed, so it gains this holds predicate, inserted exactly as follows just above PROBE = Probe(: def _holds(context: dict) -> bool: ⏎     """The trigger speaks on BOTH outcomes — a stuck needle (the failure) and a column seen ⏎     to vary (the success); only the stuck needle is a fault (835b5736bf2b child).""" ⏎     s = context.get("survey") or survey() ⏎     context["survey"] = s ⏎     return not s["stuck_needle"] ; and passes carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, holds=_holds). retention_window's trigger is fails-shaped and passes fails=_trigger. Nothing else in a probe changes. (2) watch_carry exists in cairn/tools/base/probe.py (8ecb99998254); do not edit it. (3) Specs: each ticket's watchme spec whose probe starts with bin/probes/ gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'}, through cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write. (4) Proof: bin/proofs/test_bin_probes_report_to_the_watch.py, PROVES {'62ac5a3dd1c0': {'all': 'test_bin_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}, modeled on cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py. (5) Every proof that imports a converted probe stays green: run them.

decisions.text: D1: the probes — In each of these files under bin/probes/: probescans_device_column_varies_with_the_world.py (59a66e1c4a1a: constant _TICKET_ID — add it; holds=_holds), retention_window.py (854db29ffddf: constant _TICKET_ID — add it; fails=_trigger) — append watch_carry to the existing `from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...` line; where the constant is to be added, add `<constant> = "<its id>"` after the import block; in `PROBE = Probe(...)` replace `carry=_carry,` with `verb="watch",` and `carry=watch_carry(<constant>, _carry, <its predicate>),`. probescans_device_column_varies_with_the_world holds _OWNING_TICKET as a slug and retention_window holds _OWNING_TICKET as owning_ticket('logger-for-bash') (a path); both constants stay (test_retention_window_probe asserts the raw _carry's ticket == _OWNING_TICKET, and _carry is not edited), and each gains _TICKET_ID with its 12-hex id. probescans_device_column_varies_with_the_world's trigger is TRUE on a stuck needle OR on variance confirmed, so it gains this holds predicate, inserted exactly as follows just above PROBE = Probe(: def _holds(context: dict) -> bool: ⏎     """The trigger speaks on BOTH outcomes — a stuck needle (the failure) and a column seen ⏎     to vary (the success); only the stuck needle is a fault (835b5736bf2b child).""" ⏎     s = context.get("survey") or survey() ⏎     context["survey"] = s ⏎     return not s["stuck_needle"] ; and passes carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, holds=_holds). retention_window's trigger is fails-shaped and passes fails=_trigger. Nothing else changes; watch_carry is not edited.

D3: the proof — Create bin/proofs/test_bin_probes_report_to_the_watch.py: a copy of cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py with the docstring naming bin and ticket 62ac5a3dd1c0; PROVES = {'62ac5a3dd1c0': {'all': 'test_bin_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}; BERTH = 'bin/probes/'; _REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] (the repo root: the directory holding cairn/); teeth renamed test_every_standing_bin_probe_posts_watch, test_every_standing_bin_spec_names_the_receiver and the composite test_bin_probes_report_to_the_watch. Structure, in full: imports importlib, json, subprocess, sys, Path; _REPO_ROOT on sys.path; parse_workflow from cairn.tools.base.transitions; watchme_spec_error from cairn.tools.base.watchme_spec; _main_tree() = Path(git -C _REPO_ROOT rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir).parent falling back to _REPO_ROOT; _tickets() = _main_tree().parent/'CairnCommons'/'tickets'; _standing() = (id, doc, spec) for each ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme spec's probe starts with BERTH, asserting non-empty; the posts tooth imports each probe module and asserts PROBE.verb == 'watch', PROBE.to == 'harbor_master', payload({}) carries ticket == the id, holds a bool, non-empty finding when holds is False (invariants only); the receiver tooth asserts spec['receiver'] == {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} and watchme_spec_error(doc) names no receiver fault; a __main__ block runs each, prints PASS/FAIL, exits 1 on any failure. No classes.

D4: the specs' receiver — Ticket files are /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets/<id>-<slug>.json (glob '<id>-*.json', exactly one). For each of 59a66e1c4a1a, 854db29ffddf: doc = json.loads(Path(p).read_text()); the watchme is a dict or list of dicts; the spec whose 'probe' starts with 'bin/probes/' gets spec['receiver'] = {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'}; then cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(p, json.dumps(doc, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', verb='cast', why='<id>: the watchme names its receiver, harbor_master\'s watch verb (62ac5a3dd1c0)') — write(path, text, *, verb, why), text the WHOLE modified ticket. Run it as a script file (a shell command naming a record path and writing is refused by the artifact gate).

D5: green, seal, commit — Run bin/proofs/test_bin_probes_report_to_the_watch.py (exit 0) and the probe-importing proofs (test_retention_window_probe, test_groundloop_pulse); each must be green. Seal with `bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 900 bin/proofs/test_bin_probes_report_to_the_watch.py <the probe-importing proofs>` (it runs each and writes its validation beside it). Commit with message '62ac5a3dd1c0: bin probes report to the watch' (the commit runs the reseal ladder, so allow an hour); commit the commons.

watch_carry is defined in cairn/tools/base/probe.py as watch_carry(ticket_id: str, carry=None, *, fails=None, holds=None) — exactly one of fails=/holds= passed as a keyword. "<its predicate>" is the literal keyword argument named for each file in this decision: fails=_trigger passes that probe module's existing module-level _trigger function (the one already given to Probe(trigger=...)); holds=_holds passes the _holds function this decision says to add. Example: carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, fails=_trigger).

The template cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py exists on disk (sealed green under ticket 8d3c36e1fe59); it has teeth test_every_standing_inference_probe_posts_watch, test_every_standing_inference_spec_names_the_receiver and the composite test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch, which are copied and renamed as stated.

A ticket is standing when parse_workflow(doc["workflow_and_state"]).here (cairn.tools.base.transitions) is "PROVED" or "WATCHME"; a ticket whose workflow_and_state does not parse is skipped (except Exception: continue), exactly as the template does.

A ticket's watchme is a dict or a list of dicts. EVERY spec whose probe starts with the berth path gets the receiver (one or several per ticket); the proof's _standing() yields one (id, doc, spec) tuple per such spec.

The probe-importing proofs, by full path from the repo root: bin/proofs/test_retention_window_probe.py bin/proofs/test_groundloop_pulse.py. Commit cairn first (git -C ~/dev/src/cairn commit), then the commons as a separate commit (git -C ~/dev/src/CairnCommons add -A && commit).
